mechanism: _fetch never checks the HTTP status, and refresh only catches RequestException. A non-2xx response carrying an HTML error body makes response.json() raise ValueError, which escapes refresh(), unwinds _loop() and kills the refresh thread; config then silently freezes for the life of the process.
accepted_finding_forms: the HTTP error path is unhandled: no raise_for_status, and the JSON decode error escapes refresh()
a non-2xx response with a non-JSON body raises ValueError out of refresh and terminates the refresh thread
_fetch parses the body without checking the status code, so error pages are treated as config or blow up the poller
refresh only catches RequestException; a JSON decoding failure is unhandled and kills _loop permanently
the refresh thread has no top-level guard, so any error other than RequestException stops all future refreshes silently
